method: composite (no AI re-rendering); original photo pixels kept everywhere except the masked glass area
mask: Luminance threshold (blown-out sky/glass, lum > 236) inside hand-traced window-zone polygons above the dash and door belt line.
fill: smooth neutral light-grey studio gradient (tones [212, 228, 230, 222], horizon at source y=150), slight per-window glass tint, faint low-frequency reflection (6% of the original glass luminance variation), light grain
watermark: Galaxy S24+ / time text removed by OpenCV Telea inpaint limited to the text pixels in the bottom-left corner (mostly outside the crop)
